issue_context.title: Document public QueryState methods
issue_context.body: QueryState is the api people use when querying World directly, but it doesn't have any documentation.  Query (the type used in Systems) does have documentation for the methods that it exposes on QueryState. We should copy / adapt the documentation in Query to QueryState.
comments: I will be happy to take this on.

review_comments: this doc should be as explicit as `iter_combinations` (or link to it, but I would prefer to copy here for help in IDE)
